name: player_build_gun_fire_transform
description: Player::BuildGunFireTransform copies the root Object3D matrix when no modal node exists and otherwise combines the modal-node matrix with selected root matrix axes into playerState->gunFireTransform.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the fastcall save-state ABI, root matrix copy from playerState->rootNode, no-modal memcpy directly into playerState->gunFireTransform, modal-node matrix copy from primaryModalState->modalNode, and the recovered unrolled matrix combine into playerState offset 0x320.

The native smoke checks the no-modal root-matrix copy and a modal-node transform case with nontrivial root/modal matrices before exercising the adjacent aim-basis composition and fire-point selection behavior.

Binary Ninja still carries a limited reconstruction marker because the original uses unrolled x87 float arithmetic; no VC manifest covers 0x43b1b0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a player aim/source-cluster pass.
